result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but one visible localization/content error and a couple of potentially problematic clipping/overlay issues stand out.

issues.description: The section heading displays the untranslated key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of a user-facing title.
issues.suggestion: Resolve the localization key and display the intended heading, such as "Popular near you" or the appropriate translated text.

issues.description: The horizontal category and restaurant carousels are cut off at the right edge, leaving partial pills/cards visible.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the clipped items are clearly presented as horizontally scrollable, or adjust spacing and carousel affordances so the partial item does not look accidentally truncated.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card appears to continue underneath the fixed bottom navigation, making its content visibly obscured at the bottom of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so cards can be fully viewed above the fixed navigation bar.
